headline: ARREST 🛑 Made After BLACK 👩🏾‍🦱 Woman Found HANGED 🪢 From TREE 🌳 In MISSISSIPPI 🐊
text:
POLICE 🚔 in Mississippi 🐊 have finally ARRESTED 🔗 a man over the DEATH ☠️ of Tasia Fortune whose BODY 🪦 was found HANGED 🪢 from a TREE 🌳 on the grounds of an ABANDONED 🏚️ home in Jackson back in AUGUST ☀️ but they only just announced they were treating her DEATH ☠️ as a possible HOMICIDE 🩸 earlier this WEEK 📅!! Jackson Police Chief RaShall Brackney said that ARREST 🔗 today is an important DEVELOPMENT 📈 in this INVESTIGATION 🕵️ but it is NOT ❌ the conclusion and this CASE 📋 remains very much ACTIVE 🏃!! Fortune's DEATH ☠️ has left locals in the majority BLACK 🖤 city totally WORRIED 😟 especially given Mississippi's DARK 🌑 history of racial VIOLENCE ⚔️ and LYNCHING 🪢!! The medical examiner confirmed her cause of DEATH ☠️ was HOMICIDE 🩸 and there WILL 🗣️ be a MURDER 🔪 charge with the SUSPECT 🕴️ identified as Jarques Ratliff age 51 who also happens to be BLACK 🖤 and had some kind of ASSOCIATION 🤝 with Fortune though they wouldn't spill any more TEA ☕ on that!!

Brackney added that ADDITIONAL 🔗 arrests will be PENDING ⏳ as their investigators continue to FOLLOW 👣 the EVIDENCE 🧾 after already interviewing FIFTEEN 🕒 different people in the CASE 📋!! Fortune's mother Christy Spivey told the BBC she straight up CRIED 😢 when police CALLED 📞 to update her about the ARREST 🔗 saying she does feel like a little SIGH 😮‍💨 of relief and a little bit of PEACE 🕊️ just came over her but she still HOPES 🙏 they've got the RIGHT ✅ person!! The ARREST 🔗 of this suspect came after weeks of what Spivey and Jackson residents called total SILENCE 🤫 and INACTION 🛑 from local officials which combined with the GRIM 😣 nature of the hanging DEATH ☠️ and that heavy Mississippi LYNCHING 🪢 history left the whole COMMUNITY 🏘️ in total SHOCK ⚡ and FEAR 😨!!

Spivey had earlier told the BBC she tried contacting Jackson POLICE 🚔 several times over the last two WEEKS 📆 leaving multiple VOICEMAILS 📼 and heard nothing BACK 🔙 until now!! Brackney addressed the family's FRUSTRATION 😤 on Friday by saying they have been in CONSTANT 🔄 contact with the mother and the stepfather as well as the biological FATHER 👨 throughout this entire CASE 📋!! A letter that Spivey wrote to officials about the limited COMMUNICATION 📣 and slow SPEED 🐢 of the investigation was READ 📖 out loud during a public city MEETING 🏛️ on Tuesday just moments before Jackson police dropped the ANNOUNCEMENT 📢 about a possible HOMICIDE 🩸!! Spivey said she was kind of in AWE 😲 like she can't believe it and that was actually pretty QUICK ⚡ after all the waiting!!

Earlier this month Fortune's DEATH ☠️ was described by a member of the US Congress as part of a PATTERN 📊 of possible modern day LYNCHINGS 🪢!! More than FIFTY 5️⃣0️⃣ members of Congress this week sent a letter to the FBI and justice department saying they were extremely ALARMED 🚨 by reports of BLACK 🖤 people found HANGING 🪢 from trees in numerous STATES 🗺️ and calling for an independent INVESTIGATION 🕵️ into the deaths of BLACK 🖤 Americans!! The letter states that this series of DEATHS ☠️ raise significant SUSPICION 🕵️ of foul PLAY 🎲 given the horrible ROLE 📜 of lynching in our nation's HISTORY 📖!!

So far this YEAR 📅 there have been at least TEN 🔟 reported deaths of BLACK 🖤 people by hanging in the US the members of Congress said and their letter also cited a report by an advocacy group which documented more than SEVENTY 7️⃣0️⃣ suspected modern day LYNCHINGS 🪢 in southern states between 2000 and 2025!! Those statistics have been heavily CONTESTED ⚔️ and it is important to note that the group's definition went beyond just RACE 🏁 to also include killings allegedly motivated by sex and gender DISCRIMINATION 🚫!! In most of those incidents the deaths were officially ruled as SUICIDES 🪢 but the community still demands full ANSWERS ❓ and justice after all this PAIN 💔!!
